req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* is present on ALL responses. To achieve high mutation kill rate, tests must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence, (2) cover multiple endpoints to ensure the header is universal, (3) test that the header is absent when it should not be (negative path via a non-existent route returning 404), (4) test boundary conditions like OPTIONS preflight and redirect responses, and (5) verify the exact string '*' to catch mutations that change the wildcard value. Each test uses the in-process Flask test client.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin header missing'
    assert acao == '*', f'Expected "*" but got "{acao}"'

test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint()

tests.name: test_cors_header_exact_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin
actions: Send GET request to /headers with an Origin header
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header equals '*' not the specific origin sent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: Access-Control-Allow-Origin must be '*' (wildcard), not echoed origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_exact_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'Origin': 'https://evil.example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin header missing'
    assert acao == '*', f'Expected "*" but got "{acao}"'
    assert acao != 'https://evil.example.com', 'Header must not echo the request Origin'

test_cors_header_exact_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin()

tests.name: test_cors_header_value_is_exactly_asterisk_not_empty
actions: Assert header value is non-empty and exactly '*'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: value must be '*' — catches mutations to empty string, None, or other values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_value_is_exactly_asterisk_not_empty():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao is not None
    assert acao != ''
    assert acao != 'null'
    assert acao != 'false'
    assert len(acao) == 1, f'Expected single char "*" but got "{acao}" (len={len(acao)})'
    assert acao == '*', f'Expected "*" but got "{acao}"'

test_cors_header_value_is_exactly_asterisk_not_empty()

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_multiple_endpoints_decision_table
actions: Send requests to multiple endpoints covering different HTTP methods
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: ALL responses across all endpoints must include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=*
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_header_present_multiple_endpoints_decision_table():
    client = app.test_client()
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get', None),
        ('POST', '/post', None),
        ('PUT', '/put', None),
        ('PATCH', '/patch', None),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', None),
        ('GET', '/headers', None),
        ('GET', '/cookies', None),
    ]
    for method, path, data in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, data=data)
        acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
        assert acao is not None, f'Missing ACAO on {method} {path}'
        assert acao == '*', f'{method} {path}: expected "*" got "{acao}"'

test_cors_header_present_multiple_endpoints_decision_table()
